{{Quote|Looks like a few Tusken Raiders are camped out on the Canyon Dune Turn.|Fodesinbeed Annodue mentions Orr'UrRuuR'R and his companions during podracer commentary|audio=Fode-TuskenRaiders.flac|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Orr'UrRuuR'R''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He was in charge of the small groups of Tuskens who lined the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] course in an attempt to shoot down passing [[Podracing/Legends|podracers]].
